title: Vocabulary and Word Meaning — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses "lend" or "borrow" correctly.

visual.text: Can you lend me your dictionary until Friday?

choices.say: Can you lend me your dictionary until Friday?

visual.text: Can you borrow me your dictionary until Friday?

choices.say: Can you borrow me your dictionary until Friday?

visual.text: Can I lend your dictionary until Friday?

choices.say: Can I lend your dictionary until Friday?

visual.text: Can you borrow your dictionary to me until Friday?

choices.say: Can you borrow your dictionary to me until Friday?

items.reteach: Lend = meminjamkan (memberi); borrow = meminjam (menerima). "Lend me", "borrow from you".

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "The new rule will effect all students who come late."
items.reteach: "Affect" (kata kerja) = memengaruhi; "effect" (kata benda) = akibat. Seharusnya "will affect".

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "My father gave me some good advise about choosing friends."
items.reteach: "Advice" (kata benda) = nasihat; "advise" (kata kerja) = menasihati. Seharusnya "good advice".

items.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses "rise" or "raise" correctly.

visual.text: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

choices.say: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

visual.text: The sun raises in the east and sets in the west.

choices.say: The sun raises in the east and sets in the west.

visual.text: Please rise your hand before you speak.

choices.say: Please rise your hand before you speak.

visual.text: Prices have raised a lot this year.

choices.say: Prices have raised a lot this year.

items.reteach: Rise = naik sendiri (tanpa objek); raise = menaikkan sesuatu (dengan objek): raise your hand.

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "Be careful not to loose your ticket on the train."
items.reteach: "Lose" = kehilangan; "loose" = longgar. Seharusnya "not to lose your ticket".

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "We bought some stationary, such as pens and folders, at the shop."
items.reteach: "Stationery" = alat tulis; "stationary" = diam/tidak bergerak.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses "remind" or "remember" correctly.

visual.text: Please remind me to bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

choices.say: Please remind me to bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

visual.text: Please remember me to bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

choices.say: Please remember me to bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

visual.text: Please remind me bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

choices.say: Please remind me bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

visual.text: Please remember to me bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

choices.say: Please remember to me bring my swimming kit tomorrow.

items.reteach: Remind someone to do something = mengingatkan orang lain. Remember = mengingat sendiri.

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "Our school principle, Mr Hadi, opened the science fair."
items.reteach: "Principal" = kepala sekolah; "principle" = prinsip/asas.

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "After dinner, we had fruit salad for desert."
items.reteach: "Dessert" = hidangan penutup; "desert" = gurun pasir.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses "quiet" or "quite" correctly.

visual.text: The library was so quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.

choices.say: The library was so quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.

visual.text: The library was so quite that I could hear the clock ticking.

choices.say: The library was so quite that I could hear the clock ticking.

visual.text: The library was such quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.

choices.say: The library was such quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.

visual.text: The library was too quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.

choices.say: The library was too quiet that I could hear the clock ticking.

items.reteach: Quiet = sunyi; quite = cukup/agak. Pola: so + adjective + that.

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "Everyone accept Rina has handed in the science project."
items.reteach: "Except" = kecuali; "accept" = menerima. Seharusnya "Everyone except Rina".

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "This small car is very economic because it uses little fuel."
items.reteach: "Economical" = hemat; "economic" = berkaitan dengan ekonomi (economic growth).

items.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses "sensitive" or "sensible" correctly.

visual.text: Babies have sensitive skin, so their parents use mild soap.

choices.say: Babies have sensitive skin, so their parents use mild soap.

visual.text: Babies have sensible skin, so their parents use mild soap.

choices.say: Babies have sensible skin, so their parents use mild soap.

visual.text: It was sensitive of you to bring an umbrella in the rainy season.

choices.say: It was sensitive of you to bring an umbrella in the rainy season.

visual.text: Wearing a helmet on a motorbike is a sensitive idea.

choices.say: Wearing a helmet on a motorbike is a sensitive idea.

items.reteach: Sensitive = peka/mudah teriritasi; sensible = masuk akal/bijak (a sensible idea).

items.prompt: Find the word that is kurang tepat: "The judges complemented Ayu on her excellent speech."
items.reteach: "Compliment" = memuji; "complement" = melengkapi. Seharusnya "complimented Ayu".

items.prompt: Read the notice about the computer lab. What is the purpose of the notice?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The computer lab will be closed on Friday for maintenance. Students who need to print assignments should use the library printers. Thank you for your cooperation.

visual.text: to inform students that the lab will be closed and where to print

choices.say: to inform students that the lab will be closed and where to print

visual.text: to invite students to a computer class

choices.say: to invite students to a computer class

visual.text: to sell new printers to students

choices.say: to sell new printers to students

visual.text: to explain how to repair a computer

choices.say: to explain how to repair a computer

items.reteach: Purpose = tujuan teks. Notice ini memberi tahu penutupan lab dan pilihan lain untuk mencetak.

items.prompt: In the notice about the computer lab, the word "maintenance" refers to …

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The computer lab will be closed on Friday for maintenance. Students who need to print assignments should use the library printers. Thank you for your cooperation.

items.reteach: Maintenance = pemeliharaan, yaitu memeriksa dan memperbaiki peralatan.

items.prompt: According to the notice about the computer lab, where can students print their assignments on Friday?

stimulus.text: NOTICE: The computer lab will be closed on Friday for maintenance. Students who need to print assignments should use the library printers. Thank you for your cooperation.

items.reteach: Detail: "should use the library printers".

items.prompt: Read the text about mangroves. What is the main idea of the text?

stimulus.text: Mangroves grow along muddy coasts. Their tangled roots trap soil and slow down waves. Because of this, they act as a natural barrier that shields coastal villages from storms.

visual.text: Mangroves protect coastal areas from waves and storms.

choices.say: Mangroves protect coastal areas from waves and storms.

visual.text: Mangroves grow best in sandy deserts.

choices.say: Mangroves grow best in sandy deserts.

visual.text: Villages near the coast have many storms.

choices.say: Villages near the coast have many storms.

visual.text: Muddy coasts are dangerous for children.

choices.say: Muddy coasts are dangerous for children.

items.reteach: Main idea = gagasan utama. Seluruh teks menjelaskan fungsi mangrove melindungi pantai.

items.prompt: In the text about mangroves, the word "Their" in the second sentence refers to …

stimulus.text: Mangroves grow along muddy coasts. Their tangled roots trap soil and slow down waves. Because of this, they act as a natural barrier that shields coastal villages from storms.

items.reteach: Reference: "Their tangled roots" = akar mangrove.

items.prompt: In the text about mangroves, "shields" is used to mean …

stimulus.text: Mangroves grow along muddy coasts. Their tangled roots trap soil and slow down waves. Because of this, they act as a natural barrier that shields coastal villages from storms.

items.reteach: Shield = perisai; sebagai kata kerja berarti melindungi.

items.prompt: Based on the text about mangroves, what would most likely happen if the mangroves were cut down?

stimulus.text: Mangroves grow along muddy coasts. Their tangled roots trap soil and slow down waves. Because of this, they act as a natural barrier that shields coastal villages from storms.

visual.text: Coastal villages would suffer more damage from storms.

choices.say: Coastal villages would suffer more damage from storms.

visual.text: The waves along the coast would become slower.

choices.say: The waves along the coast would become slower.

visual.text: The soil would stay trapped near the coast.

choices.say: The soil would stay trapped near the coast.

visual.text: The villages would have fewer storms.

choices.say: The villages would have fewer storms.

items.reteach: Inference: tanpa "natural barrier", ombak dan badai lebih mudah merusak desa pantai.

items.prompt: In the text about Raka's phone, the word "freezing" means …

stimulus.text: Raka's phone kept freezing, so he deleted the apps he never used and cleared its storage. Since then, the device has run smoothly, and the battery lasts longer.

items.reteach: Vocabulary in context: untuk gawai, "freeze" berarti macet/tidak merespons, bukan membeku.

items.prompt: In the text about Raka's phone, "the device" refers to …

stimulus.text: Raka's phone kept freezing, so he deleted the apps he never used and cleared its storage. Since then, the device has run smoothly, and the battery lasts longer.

items.reteach: Reference: "the device" menunjuk kembali ke ponsel Raka.

items.prompt: Why did Raka's phone start to run smoothly?

stimulus.text: Raka's phone kept freezing, so he deleted the apps he never used and cleared its storage. Since then, the device has run smoothly, and the battery lasts longer.

visual.text: because he removed unused apps and freed up storage

choices.say: because he removed unused apps and freed up storage

visual.text: because he bought a new battery

choices.say: because he bought a new battery

visual.text: because he kept the phone in a cold place

choices.say: because he kept the phone in a cold place

items.reteach: Detail sebab-akibat: menghapus aplikasi dan mengosongkan memori membuat ponsel lancar.

items.prompt: Use the science glossary. Complete: "The slopes around Mount Bromo have ___ soil, so farmers grow vegetables there."
items.reteach: Fertile = subur, baik untuk menanam.

items.prompt: Use the science glossary. Complete: "An eagle is a ___ that catches snakes and mice."
items.reteach: Predator = hewan pemangsa yang memburu hewan lain.

items.prompt: Use the science glossary. Complete: "On a hot afternoon, the water in a puddle will slowly ___."
items.reteach: Evaporate = menguap, berubah dari cair menjadi gas.

items.prompt:
At the library.
Librarian: "You can ___ up to three books for one week."
Ayu: "Great, I'll take these two."
items.reteach: Pengunjung meminjam (borrow) buku dari perpustakaan; perpustakaan meminjamkan (lend).

items.prompt:
At a fruit market in Malang.
Seller: "These apples are 25,000 rupiah a kilo."
Sinta: "Can you give me a ___? I'm buying five kilos."
items.reteach: Discount = potongan harga. Refund = uang kembali setelah barang dikembalikan.

items.prompt:
At the clinic.
Doctor: "Take this medicine three times a day after meals."
Dimas: "Are there any side ___?"
items.reteach: "Side effects" = efek samping obat.

items.prompt:
In the computer lab.
Raka: "My file disappeared when the electricity went off!"
Teacher: "Next time, ___ your work every few minutes."
items.reteach: Save = menyimpan file agar tidak hilang.

items.prompt:
At Juanda Airport.
Officer: "May I see your ___, please?"
Passenger: "Here it is. My seat is 12A."
items.reteach: Boarding pass = pas naik pesawat yang mencantumkan nomor kursi.

items.prompt:
In class.
Ayu: "Why do we put plastic and paper in different bins?"
Teacher: "So they can be ___ into new products."
items.reteach: Recycle = mendaur ulang sampah menjadi barang baru.

items.prompt:
Before a trip.
Dimas: "Should I bring an umbrella to Batu?"
Sinta: "Yes, the weather ___ says it will rain in the afternoon."
items.reteach: Weather forecast = prakiraan cuaca. Forehead = dahi, foreword = kata pengantar.

items.prompt:
After an essay test.
Teacher: "Your essay is good, but it needs more ___ to support your opinion."
Ayu: "I'll add facts and examples."
items.reteach: Evidence = bukti (fakta, data, contoh) untuk mendukung pendapat.

items.prompt:
At a hotel in Banyuwangi.
Guest: "I'd like to ___ a room for two nights."
Receptionist: "Certainly. Which dates?"
items.reteach: Book a room = memesan kamar.

items.prompt:
In science class.
Student: "What does a thermometer ___?"
Teacher: "It shows how hot or cold something is."
items.reteach: Thermometer measures temperature = termometer mengukur suhu.

items.prompt:
On the phone.
Raka: "Sorry, you're ___ up. I can't hear you clearly."
Sinta: "The signal is weak here in the mountains."
items.reteach: "You're breaking up" = suaramu putus-putus (sinyal lemah).

items.prompt:
At a museum in Surabaya.
Guide: "Please do not touch the ___; some of these objects are over 200 years old."
Visitor: "Of course."
items.reteach: Exhibits = benda pameran di museum.

items.prompt:
At the bus terminal.
Passenger: "What time does the bus to Sumenep ___?"
Officer: "It leaves at nine o'clock."
items.reteach: Depart = berangkat (= leave). Deposit = menyetor, depend = bergantung.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: waste / reduces / in landfills / recycling / the amount of

visual.text: Recycling reduces the amount of waste in landfills.

choices.say: Recycling reduces the amount of waste in landfills.

visual.text: Recycling the amount of waste reduces in landfills.

choices.say: Recycling the amount of waste reduces in landfills.

visual.text: The amount of recycling reduces waste in landfills.

choices.say: The amount of recycling reduces waste in landfills.

visual.text: Waste reduces recycling the amount of in landfills.

choices.say: Waste reduces recycling the amount of in landfills.

items.reteach: Pola: subject (Recycling) + verb (reduces) + object (the amount of waste) + keterangan.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: to save / were / the students / encouraged / water at school

visual.text: The students were encouraged to save water at school.

choices.say: The students were encouraged to save water at school.

visual.text: The students were to save encouraged water at school.

choices.say: The students were to save encouraged water at school.

visual.text: The students encouraged were to save water at school.

choices.say: The students encouraged were to save water at school.

visual.text: Were the students to save encouraged water at school.

choices.say: Were the students to save encouraged water at school.

items.reteach: Passive: subject + were + encouraged + to + verb.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: the way / smartphones / people communicate / have changed

visual.text: Smartphones have changed the way people communicate.

choices.say: Smartphones have changed the way people communicate.

visual.text: Smartphones the way have changed people communicate.

choices.say: Smartphones the way have changed people communicate.

visual.text: The way smartphones people communicate have changed.

choices.say: The way smartphones people communicate have changed.

visual.text: People communicate smartphones have changed the way.

choices.say: People communicate smartphones have changed the way.

items.reteach: "The way people communicate" = cara orang berkomunikasi, menjadi objek dari "have changed".

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: every year / attracts / thousands of tourists / the volcano

visual.text: The volcano attracts thousands of tourists every year.

choices.say: The volcano attracts thousands of tourists every year.

visual.text: The volcano every year thousands of tourists attracts.

choices.say: The volcano every year thousands of tourists attracts.

visual.text: Thousands of tourists the volcano attracts every year.

choices.say: Thousands of tourists the volcano attracts every year.

visual.text: Attracts the volcano thousands of tourists every year.

choices.say: Attracts the volcano thousands of tourists every year.

items.reteach: Pola SVO + keterangan waktu di akhir.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: clearly / explained / our teacher / of the word / the meaning

visual.text: Our teacher explained the meaning of the word clearly.

choices.say: Our teacher explained the meaning of the word clearly.

visual.text: Our teacher the meaning explained of the word clearly.

choices.say: Our teacher the meaning explained of the word clearly.

visual.text: Our teacher explained clearly of the word the meaning.

choices.say: Our teacher explained clearly of the word the meaning.

visual.text: The meaning of our teacher explained the word clearly.

choices.say: The meaning of our teacher explained the word clearly.

items.reteach: Subject + explained + object (the meaning of the word) + adverb (clearly).

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: depend on / to grow apples / farmers in Batu / fertile soil

visual.text: Farmers in Batu depend on fertile soil to grow apples.

choices.say: Farmers in Batu depend on fertile soil to grow apples.

visual.text: Farmers in Batu fertile soil depend on to grow apples.

choices.say: Farmers in Batu fertile soil depend on to grow apples.

visual.text: Fertile soil depend on farmers in Batu to grow apples.

choices.say: Fertile soil depend on farmers in Batu to grow apples.

visual.text: Farmers in Batu depend on to grow apples fertile soil.

choices.say: Farmers in Batu depend on to grow apples fertile soil.

items.reteach: "Depend on" + objek (fertile soil), lalu tujuan (to grow apples).

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: back up / you / your important files / should / regularly

visual.text: You should back up your important files regularly.

choices.say: You should back up your important files regularly.

visual.text: You should your important files back up regularly.

choices.say: You should your important files back up regularly.

visual.text: You back up should your important files regularly.

choices.say: You back up should your important files regularly.

visual.text: Should you back up regularly your important files.

choices.say: Should you back up regularly your important files.

items.reteach: Modal should + verb dasar (back up) + objek + adverb.

items.prompt: Change the word form to keep the meaning: "Ayu is a careful reader." = "Ayu reads ___."
items.reteach: Kata kerja "reads" dijelaskan oleh adverb: carefully.

items.prompt: Change the word form to keep the meaning: "The museum was impressive." = "The museum made a strong ___ on us."
items.reteach: Setelah "a strong" dibutuhkan noun: impression (kesan).

items.prompt: Change the word form to keep the meaning: "It is possible to finish the project today." = "There is a ___ that we can finish the project today."
items.reteach: Setelah "There is a" dibutuhkan noun: possibility (kemungkinan).

items.prompt: Change the word form to keep the meaning: "Plastic is harmful to sea animals." = "Plastic can ___ sea animals."
items.reteach: Setelah modal "can" dipakai verb dasar: harm (membahayakan).

items.prompt: Change the word form to keep the meaning: "The guide described the cave in detail." = "The guide gave a detailed ___ of the cave."
items.reteach: Setelah "a detailed" dibutuhkan noun: description (gambaran).

items.prompt: Change the word form to keep the meaning: "The old bridge is not safe to cross." = "Crossing the old bridge is ___."
items.reteach: Setelah "is" dibutuhkan adjective: unsafe (tidak aman).

items.prompt: Riddle: "I have keys but open no locks. I have a space but no room. You can enter, but you cannot go inside." What am I?
items.reteach: Keyboard punya keys (tombol), tombol space, dan tombol enter.

items.prompt: Odd one out: librarian, principal, caretaker, passenger. Which word does not belong?
items.reteach: Librarian, principal, caretaker bekerja di sekolah; passenger = penumpang.

items.prompt: Analogy: Telescope is to stars as microscope is to …
items.reteach: Teleskop untuk melihat bintang yang jauh; mikroskop untuk melihat benda sangat kecil seperti sel.

items.prompt: Analogy: Author is to novel as composer is to …
items.reteach: Author menulis novel; composer menciptakan lagu/musik.

items.prompt: Letter code: If CAT is written as DBU (each letter moves one step forward), how is TREE written?
items.reteach: T→U, R→S, E→F, E→F. Jadi TREE = USFF.

items.prompt: Word logic: "I am a room where scientists do experiments. People often shorten me to three letters." Which word am I?
items.reteach: Laboratory sering disingkat "lab".

items.prompt: Which word can come before all three: ___ball, ___print, ___path?
items.reteach: Football, footprint, footpath. "Hand" tidak cocok dengan "path".

items.prompt: Riddle: "I fall from clouds as tiny drops, fill rivers and lakes, and help seeds grow. When I stay away too long, there is a drought." What am I?
items.reteach: Rain = hujan. Drought = kemarau panjang karena tidak ada hujan.

items.prompt: Which single word fits both sentences? "Please ___ the table for dinner." and "The sun will ___ at six o'clock."
items.reteach: Set the table = menata meja; the sun sets = matahari terbenam. "Lay" hanya cocok di kalimat pertama.

items.prompt: Which single word fits both sentences? "He wore a gold ___ on his finger." and "Please ___ me when you arrive."
items.reteach: Ring = cincin (noun) dan menelepon (verb). "Call" dan "text" tidak cocok di kalimat pertama.

items.prompt: Unscramble the letters T-E-M-I-L-A-C to find a word meaning "the usual weather of a place over a long time".
items.reteach: TEMILAC = CLIMATE (iklim): pola cuaca jangka panjang.

items.prompt: Analogy: Thermometer is to temperature as scale is to …
items.reteach: Termometer mengukur suhu; timbangan (scale) mengukur berat.

items.prompt: Which word still makes a real English word when its first letter is removed?
items.reteach: scare → care. Music → usic, pencil → encil, river → iver bukan kata.
